targets_a.kind: H-H, equivalent to fixing the H-O-H angle at 104.52 deg

degrees_of_freedom.derivation: 3N - constraints = 9 - 3; the COM velocity is KEPT for this case

provenance.compiler_note: Apple clang, arm64; the metrics are not bit-portable across compilers but every tolerance has orders of magnitude of headroom.
provenance.generation_command:
python3 validation/constrained_nve_water/generate_fixture.py   # fixtures
python3 validation/run_validation.py --case constrained_nve_water --gmd <build>/gmd --gmd-validate <build>/gmd_validate --work-root <work>   # metrics
provenance.statement: The PHYSICS checks in this case are ANALYTIC: conservation of energy, linear momentum and angular momentum for a force-free rigid body, the straight-line motion of its centre of mass, and the collapse of the reported pressure to the ideal-gas value M|v_com|^2/3V once the constraint virial has cancelled the rotational kinetic energy. None of those expected values came from GMD. The numbers under 'recorded_observations' below are NOT references and are NOT compared against; they are GMD REGRESSION RESULTS recorded so a reviewer can see what this build produced. No independent external engine was used: LAMMPS, GROMACS and OpenMM do not expose a constraint virial in a form that could be compared component by component.

recorded_observations._comment: GMD regression results, recorded not compared. See provenance.statement.

run.seed_note: velocity_init is 'input', so no random draw takes place and no seed affects the result

system.note: force free: the molecule is alone in the cell and every intramolecular pair is excluded with zero force constants
